Sentences from Tatoeba
=====================

Source            https://tatoeba.org
Export            Tatoeba per-language exports: jpn_sentences_detailed.tsv, jpn-eng_links.tsv, eng_sentences.tsv (last modified Sat, 03 Oct 2026 06:29:49 GMT)

Also included     CC0 1.0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ for the sentences the corpus lists as CC0
Segmented with    lindera 6.2 (unidic-mecab-2.1.2) at build time
Selection         one sentence of 6–32 characters ending in a single full stop, question or exclamation mark, with no Latin letters, brackets, quotation marks or whitespace; an English translation in the corpus; a named contributor, because CC BY 2.0 FR requires the author to be named; not tagged `not a sentence` or `@possible copyright infringement`; and every kanji-bearing word a word the course teaches. The 200 shortest of each band are kept.
Shipped           1400 Japanese sentences, from 152 contributors

Why this file exists
---------------------

Tatoeba's sentences are contributed under CC BY 2.0 FR, which requires the author of
each one to be named. Naming them one per line inside the app would be a wall of names
longer than the phrases themselves, so they are named here: one line per contributor,
with the Tatoeba sentence ids taken from them. Every phrase in the app also carries its
own id, so a sentence can be looked up at https://tatoeba.org/en/sentences/show/<id>.

The text of each sentence is unchanged. This app adds what the corpus does not have —
a word segmentation, a reading over every kanji, a level on this course's own ladder
and the English translation the corpus pairs with it — and leaves out the sentences
that use a word the course does not teach.
